title: REV Quezon City Half Marathon 2026 Review: Manila's Metro Half Marathon
seo_title: REV QC Half Marathon 2026 Review | Quezon City Philippines
meta_description: The REV Quezon City Half-Marathon 2026: December 13 in Quezon City, Metro Manila. A 21K and 10K in the Philippines' most populous city — registration details pending.
dek: Set for 13 December 2026 in Quezon City — Metro Manila's largest and most populous component city — this REV-branded half marathon offers 21K and 10K distances. Registration isn't open yet, but for Manila-based runners, it's a convenient, accessible option worth watching.
verdict: The REV Quezon City Half-Marathon is a Metro Manila road race in Quezon City — the Philippines' most populous city and a key component of the capital region's running scene. Two distances (21K and 10K) keep it focused, and the December date catches the tail end of the Philippine typhoon season, which means conditions should be cooling into the dry season. Registration isn't open yet and the reliability score is low, which means details are thin. For Manila-based runners, it's a convenient local option to watch; for international runners, wait for more detail before committing.

sections.heading: The Location: Quezon City, Metro Manila
paragraphs: Quezon City is the Philippines' largest city by population and a key hub in the Metro Manila running scene — it's home to the UP Diliman academic oval, one of the country's most popular running loops, and several major thoroughfares that can support a half marathon course. [1] December is the transition into the dry season, offering more predictable conditions than the typhoon-prone months.

sections.heading: Should You Watch — or Book?
paragraphs: Don't book flights for this one yet — registration isn't open and the organiser details are thin. But for Manila-based runners, it's a convenient half marathon to track. The 2026 edition is set for 13 December in Quezon City. [1]
